DB.description: CloudMail account/configuration database. Cloudflare will provision this D1 database during deployment.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password used to sign in to your CloudMail web interface. Use a strong unique password.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A long random secret used to sign CloudMail sessions. Generate a unique random value (32+ bytes recommended).

CREDENTIAL_KEY.description: A separate long random secret used to encrypt mailbox passwords, app-passwords, OAuth refresh tokens and proxy passwords/PSKs with AES-GCM. Do not reuse SESSION_SECRET.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.description: Microsoft Entra application (client) ID. Required only for Outlook/Microsoft 365 OAuth.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Microsoft Entra application client secret. Store as a Cloudflare Secret. Required only for Microsoft OAuth.

MICROSOFT_TENANT.description: Microsoft tenant identifier. Use common to support personal Microsoft accounts and multi-tenant organizational accounts.
